label: Grounded contemporary Moroccan women’s Islamic political agency in Sufi spiritual interiority
description: Drawing on Sufi traditions of spiritual devotion and moral fearlessness, Yassine articulated a non-violent Islamic political ethics led by women.
dialecticalTension: Mobilizes Sufi inner purification as anti-authoritarian civic courage.

label: Engaged Moroccan feminist critiques of patriarchal fiqh while advocating endogenous Islamic democracy
description: Working in the same Moroccan public sphere as Mernissi, Yassine rejected secular-liberal imitation while demanding women’s leadership and democratic accountability.
dialecticalTension: Bridges secular-historical Moroccan feminism and activist Sufi-democratic reform.
historicalContext: Contemporary Moroccan gender and political debate (2000s).
